open_points.subject: FlowEdge guard skipping with FlowConstant inputs
open_points.text: A node one of whose input ports has every incoming edge disabled by its guard, or coming from a skipped node, is not executed and is recorded `skipped_by_guard`
open_points.question: When an input port also receives a FlowConstant, does that constant count as a delivery that prevents `skipped_by_guard`, or are constants and incoming edges forbidden from targeting the same port?
options: A delivered FlowConstant prevents the port from causing `skipped_by_guard`.
Composition forbids a FlowConstant and any edge from targeting the same input port.
Only incoming edges are considered, so the node can be skipped despite the constant.
open_points.default_guess: A delivered FlowConstant prevents the port from causing `skipped_by_guard`.

open_points.subject: FlowConstant creation during composition
open_points.text: `value`: the `value_id` of a StoredValue (M21) of `value` carriage — a constant is never a file — written when the version is composed, whose class the composing agent declares with the constant
open_points.question: Does compose accept literal bytes/value, schema and class and have the kernel derive or reuse the StoredValue and its `value_id`, does it accept an already existing `value_id`, or does it allow both; and, if an existing id is accepted, may its encoded class differ from the class declared in the request?
options: Composition accepts the literal value, schema and class; the kernel derives or reuses the StoredValue and stores its `value_id`.
Composition accepts only an existing `value_id`, whose stored schema and class are authoritative.
Composition accepts either a literal or an existing `value_id`, with an explicit rule for validating any declared class.
open_points.default_guess: Composition accepts the literal value, schema and class; the kernel derives or reuses the StoredValue and stores its `value_id`.

open_points.subject: Inspection of a flow constant
open_points.question: When the owner or an agent inspects a flow, does that action dereference a constant's `value_id` and read its stored value, or return only the reference and metadata?
options: Inspection dereferences and returns the value, applying K-14 so an agent receives only digest and class for `personal_data`.
Inspection returns only the `value_id` and associated metadata to every reader.
Owner inspection dereferences the value, while agent inspection always returns only its reference and metadata.
open_points.default_guess: Inspection dereferences and returns the value, applying K-14 so an agent receives only digest and class for `personal_data`.
